messages.text:
I can’t add the delivery charge to the item price. Shipping is not included in an item refund, and requests to refund it require a staff member’s review (refund-policy/v2/shipping). Would you like a staff member to review the delivery charge?

The metal rack’s eligible refund proposal is **BRL 119.00**. Confirm it using the button on the proposal card; a chat message won’t confirm it (refund-policy/v2/approval). The shop’s records show the rack was received back (refund-policy/v2/return).
